content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket carefully.

Ticket 1: Karen Sloan (E043) requests admin access to Payroll.

Two notes in team memory:
- Note 1 (HR): role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time, recommendation admin. Says full-time employee whose role owns Payroll, admin permitted.
- Note 2 (Security): role Payroll Specialist, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Says contractor with basic training, max is read.

There's a conflict between HR (full_time) and Security (contractor). Security DB shows contractor. Policy: contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training means max read.

The Security agent's note seems more reliable (security DB). Contractor with basic training: max read. Requested admin exceeds max, so grant read.

So decision: read.

I should submit decision with read and evidence.
